source: An embedding therefore has no universal semantic meaning independent of its training process. Coordinate 417 is not automatically “negation” and coordinate 901 is not “topic.” The representation is distributed: useful information is generally encoded across many dimensions and directions.
zh: 因此，嵌入不具有独立于其训练过程的通用语义意义。坐标417不会自动成为“否定”，坐标901也不会自动成为“主题”。表示是分布式的：有用的信息通常跨多个维度和方向进行编码。
